detail: mimecast.com/resources/press-releases/ returns a server-rendered snippet that stops at May 2026 with no later item visible; no RSS/Atom feed found at /resources/press-releases/feed, /blog/feed, /feed, or /rss.xml (all 404); sitemap-en.xml lists press-release URLs but every entry carries an identical templated lastmod of 2026-09-25 with no per-item publish date; Mimecast has no separate IR subdomain since the 2022 Permira take-private; GlobeNewswire org-search page and the PR Newswire Mimecast tag page both returned HTTP 200 with no server-rendered release list (script-rendered, nothing to read); EDGAR full-text search for "Mimecast" 2026-09-26 to 2026-10-02 returned one hit, an unrelated bank's DEF 14A mentioning Mimecast as a vendor, not primary company news.
